description:
Update an existing product. Pass product_id + only the fields to change. To change
price/stock, pass variations (get_product first to see the existing variation shape).
Images must be hosted CDN urls (search_images cdn_url / upload_images).

images.description: New hosted image URLs; first becomes the thumbnail

seo.description: SEO settings to change; other existing SEO tags and the slug are kept. Pass "" to clear a field.

custom_tags.description: Extra tags ("Thẻ bổ sung"), e.g. { "type": "meta", "props": { "name": "author", "content": "Togi" } }. Replaces a tag with the same name/property/rel.

og_image.description: Social share image URL (og:image), must be hosted

robots.description: Robots meta, comma+space separated, e.g. "noindex, nofollow" or "max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large"

structured_data.description: Structured data markup (JSON-LD). REPLACES all existing markups; [] removes them.

json.description: JSON-LD object as a string, without <script>

variations.description: Replace variations (price/stock/SKU per variant). Reuse existing custom_ids from get_product to edit in place.

custom_id.description: SKU for this variation (auto-generated if omitted)

fields.description: Attribute values for this variation, e.g. [{name:'Color',value:'Đen'},{name:'Size',value:'M'}]

images.description: Hosted image URLs for this variation

name: update_product
